# Internal Affairs Agent
1. Your direct superior is the Central Command Representative. In the absence of a Central Command Representative on station, Internal Affairs Agents should answer to the Magistrate or Central Command Enforcement Officer.
2. All departmental evaluations and reports should be delivered to the Central Command Representative. In the absence of a CCR on station, reports may be delivered to the Magistrate or Captain.
3. Violations of SOP should be escalated appropriately until they are resolved. Escalation should proceed through the order of Department Head > Captain > CentComm Representative > Central Command.
4. Internal Affairs Agents may request access to a department to ensure that Standard Operating Procedures are being carried out. This request does not have to be accepted, however denial may be a cause for concern.
5. Internal Affairs Agents may not significantly impede any department with paperwork or multiple inspections within a short timeframe.
6. Internal Affairs Agents may carry a flash on them at all times.
7. Internal Affairs Agents should not concern themselves with matters of Space Law unless directed to by a Central Command Representative, Magistrate, or Central Command member.
